  have : ModularGroup.T ^ (2 : ℕ) = ModularGroup.T ^ (2 : ℤ) := rfl

  have h1 : (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, cpow_eq_zero_iff, not_and_or]
